variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. The defiance is established; a particular punishment or response is not. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the political and legal question posed by that stance from an invented account of what the home world has done in reply.

Political principle is tested when obedience and conviction are said to pull apart. Our movement should be able to explain its judgment of authority rather than treating either compliance or defiance as automatically virtuous. A serious argument concerns legitimacy and responsibility, not the appeal of a defiant gesture alone.

We defend {target} in this assessment. Compliance is not the only possible political virtue, and a fair hearing must allow a principled challenge to authority rather than treating defiance as self-proving guilt. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
